source: sanitized Windows vendor-API output-gain encoding plus live write/read-back/exact-restore validation

golden_encoding.encoding: signed little-endian Q8.8; the same value is duplicated across both channels of the selected physical output pair

live_validation.procedure: read exact original stereo values; write a temporary 1 dB paired delta; read back; restore both original channel values; read back the raw settings block
live_validation.result: all three temporary pair values matched; all six original per-channel Q8.8 values were restored exactly

limitations: Only firmware 0x018A and the three paired physical output-gain controls are approved by this fixture.
The underlying USB setup packet has not been captured with USBPcap.
Offsets 12..17 are paired hardware-mute flags also used by the original serializer at the -60 dB endpoint; the public gain encoder now sets the selected pair at -60 dB and clears it above -60 dB.
